identificationModule.briefTitle: NEXUS Study: A Study to Test Single and Multiple Doses of MER511 Given to Adults With Graves' Disease
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 1, First-in-Human, Placebo-Controlled, Single and Multiple Ascending Dose Study to Evaluate Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics, Pharmacodynamics, and Immunogenicity of Intravenous and Subcutaneous Administration of MER511 in Adults With Graves' Disease

designInfo.interventionModelDescription: The study will enroll cohorts of participants who will be assigned to a dose group for Part A and Part B.

armGroups.label: Part A (SAD) MER511 IV
armGroups.description: For Cohorts 1-7 , each cohort participant will receive a single ascending dose of MER511 via IV administration on Day 1

armGroups.label: Part A (SAD) placebo IV
armGroups.description: For Cohorts 1-7, each cohort participant will receive a single dose of placebo via IV administration on Day 1

armGroups.label: Part A (SAD) MER511 SC
armGroups.description: For Cohort 8, participants will receive a single dose of MER511 (determined from Cohort 1-7) via SC administration on Day 1

armGroups.label: Part A (SAD) placebo SC
armGroups.description: For Cohort 8, participants will receive a single dose of placebo (determined from Cohort 1-7) via SC administration on Day 1

armGroups.label: Part B (MAD) MER511 SC
armGroups.description: Up to 3 cohorts of participants will receive multiple ascending doses of MER511 via SC administration assigned for their cohort on Day 1 and Day 29

armGroups.label: - Part B (MAD) placebo SC
armGroups.description: Up to 3 cohorts of participants will receive multiple doses of placebo via SC administration assigned for their cohort on Day 1 and Day 29

interventions.name: MER511 (IV)
interventions.description: Participants will receive a single dose of MER511 on Day 1

interventions.name: Placebo comparator (IV)
interventions.description: Participants will receive a single dose of Placebo on Day 1

interventions.name: MER511 (SC)
interventions.description: Participants will receive a single dose of MER511 on Day 1

interventions.name: Placebo comparator (SC)
interventions.description: Participants will receive a single dose of Placebo on Day 1

interventions.name: MER511 (SC) for MAD
interventions.description: Participants will receive multiple ascending doses of MER511 via SC administration assigned for their cohort on Day 1 and Day 29

interventions.name: Placebo comparator (SC) for MAD
interventions.description: Participants will receive multiple doses of placebo via SC administration assigned for their cohort on Day 1 and Day 29

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of participants with TEAEs (Treatment-emergent adverse events)
primaryOutcomes.description: Adverse events that start or worsen in severity after the start of study drug will be categorized as TEAEs
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: - Part A (SAD) Cohorts: Day 1 up to Week 16 - Part B (MAD) Cohorts: Day 1 up to Week 24

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of participants with clinically significant changes in ECGs, vital signs, clinical laboratory values, and physical examination
primaryOutcomes.description: Incidence of clinically significant abnormalities in ECGs, vital signs, clinical laboratory values, and physical examination
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: - Part A (SAD) Cohorts: Day 1 up to Week 16 - Part B (MAD) Cohorts: Day 1 up to Week 24

secondaryOutcomes.description: Measurement of the maximum observed concentration
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: - Part A (SAD) Cohorts: Day 1 (Week 0 dosing day) through Week 16- Part B (MAD) Cohorts: Day 1 (Week 0 dosing Day) Through Week 24

secondaryOutcomes.description: Measurement of the time to maximum observed concentration
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: - Part A (SAD) Cohorts: Day 1 (Week 0 dosing day) Through Week 16 - Part B (MAD) Cohorts: Day 1 (Week 0 dosing day) Through Week 24

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Serum AUCinf (area under concentration-time curve from time zero to infinity)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Measurement of area under concentration-time curve from time zero to infinity
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Part A (SAD) Only: Day 1 (Week 0) Dosing Through Week 16

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Serum AUC0-tau (area under concentration-time curve during the dosing interval)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Measurement of area under concentration-time curve during the dosing interval
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Part B (MAD) Only: Day 1 (Week 0) Dosing Through Week 24

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of participants with ADAs (Anti-drug antibody)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Blood samples will be collected to evaluate the immunogenicity of MER511 in participants with GD (Graves' disease)
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: - Part A (SAD) Cohorts: Day 1 (Week 0) Dosing Through Week 16 or Early Discontinuation - Part B (MAD) Cohorts: Day 1 (Week 0) Dosing Through Week 24
